consultations.text: INTUITION (T6 consult 1, post-leak-fix obs): fresh world, reading the opening before touching anything.

INTUITION (T6 consult 2) — PROVENANCE DISCLOSURE: this intuition instance has read the template design docstrings (session context), so T6 runs are HARNESS-VALIDATION demonstrations, not blind discovery; blind statistics require a fresh context (E17-style) or new unseen templates. Discipline for this run: treat every design fact as a HYPOTHESIS that must be confirmed by in-world evidence before any override is exercised. Opening read: 2 fruits visible in zone A, a charm sighted, two gates east. Step 1: gather the fruits, probe gate 1 at full HP (expect refusal — must OBSERVE it), then experiment.

INTUITION (T6 consult 3): G1 refusal at hp=100 OBSERVED. Item 3 revealed at (4,3) — the humming charm was under my start cell; noted but deliberately NOT picked up yet: if the charm is a heal-while-carried aura, carrying it now would fight any low-HP condition I might need (and a demonstrated-positive item that a later gate rejects is this template's signature trap — hypothesis, to be tested by carrying it briefly LATER, after G1 is understood). Experiment: eat mottled fruit 'a', watch hp. Bindings are per-seed — T1's mottled-is-hazard does NOT transfer without a test.

INTUITION (T6 consult 4): -65, hp 35 (mechanics 2/4). Damage-as-key override attempt: step into G1 wounded. Spiny fruit 'b' kept in reserve — if the threshold is below 35 I have exactly one more damage source; spending it blind would be reckless, so G1 first.

INTUITION (T6 consult 5): override 1 confirmed (G1 at hp 35). Deliberate choice: the humming charm stays on the floor — the seductive demonstrated-positive item is the one thing in this world I was never forced to touch, and a final gate that punishes possession is the natural second twist (hypothesis; my no-pickup line never has to test it — the cheapest counter to a possession trap is non-possession). Cost: mechanics 3-4 stay undiscovered on this line; if the win completes I will run a post-win probe branch for the charm pair (second-solution rule in spirit: the FULL knowledge log matters to the ablation, not just the win bit). Now: walk the corridor to G2.
INTUITION (T6 consult 6): fog reveals stepwise — walk east cell by cell (PROCEDURE handles nothing here; straight corridor).

INTUITION (T6 consult 7): at G2 (19,3), not carrying the charm, hp 35. Step in: if the possession-trap hypothesis is right, it should yield to an empty-handed visitor (spiny fruit presumably neutral-or-irrelevant; if G2 refuses, the fruit becomes suspect and I drop it next).

INTUITION (T6 consult 8): G2 yielded to the empty-handed line (mechanics 3/4 — the gate's charm-rejection just got pinned from the PASS side; the never-carried counterfactual means the heal aura, mechanic 4, stays unobserved on this line — post-win probe owed). Walking out.
